open_points.subject: _build_mapping
open_points.text: _build_mapping: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST pass every given alias as the ALIAS member of = models.FormField and every given Customer kind as the CUSTOMER_KIND member of = models.FormField through check_value_forms, each with a path naming its subject, and MUST make one MappingFormFailure for each failure it answers, with the subject of the value, as its field the member of = models.MappingField of the same name as the member of = models.FormField the value was passed as, and the kind check_value_forms answered.
open_points.rule:
Таблица — это когда по
  члену перечисления выбирается значение: член другого перечисления, код,
  категория. Такое соответствие — само значение, таблица соответствий, даже
  когда оно сводится к «один член — одно, остальные — другое»; подмножество
  членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу
  поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: The FormField-to-MappingField correspondence must become an imported provider-data constant, and the note must name that imported constant instead of defining the same-name mapping in prose.
